view3: รายการประกอบแบบ (การตอกเข็มคอนกรีตอัดแรง) + หมายเหตุ S1/S2 + รายการเพิ่มเติม — notes file
warnings: Ground/floor beams GB1-GB9, GB0, GB6' of the combined S-4 plan (footings and columns are in the footing_plan file from the same drawing).

Main hall (lines 3-11): GB1 on every column line B-C-D-E, GB2 end beams out to the edge beams GB3 on A''' and E', rows C and D all GB8, rows B and E alternate GB8 / GB7 bay by bay starting with GB8 at 3-4.

Left wing (lines 1-3) = stage (เวที) between C and D with dressing/store rooms and corner toilets. Doubled marks are printed on several lines: 'GB6/GB0' (B-C, D-E) and 'GB6'/GB6' (C-D) on lines 1 and 2, 'GB9/GB9' on B''' and D'''. Each is recorded as two beams on the same segment (one entry per printed mark) — read as a ground beam plus an upper (floor/stage-level) beam on the same wall line, since GB0 and GB6' are detailed as 7.00 ม. spans at ระดับพื้นภายใน / ระดับพื้นเวที.

Diagonal beams GB5/GB9/GB8 at the stage corners: GB9 lands on line 3 at the printed 1.00 below B (above E); their common junction is at x = 4.80 (6.00 - 1.20 printed) but its y is not printed — B''/D'''' are straight-line positions (grid master). Diagonal spans are left unresolved.
Corner-toilet partition beams GB9 (B-B''', D'''-E) and GB8 (B'''-B''''', D'-D''') are recorded on 1'' (the printed 0.95 tick) although drawn ≈0.10 m to its right.
Slab markers S1 (main hall, stage, 1-way) and S2 (rooms, toilets, stage apron) are recorded per panel with the enclosing grid box; panels cut by the diagonals are approximate.
